dek: A Cala devotee who finds purpose and relief in practical work, even while unsure what she wants beyond being useful.

body:
Nymera appears in rooms filled with people who possess older histories, specialized magic, and theories she does not always share. Her recurring response is not withdrawal. She asks what practical work remains and offers herself to it.

August · two losses in one defense

Newly helping at Skylight Refuge, Nymera remains with Arjahn and Eugene while the diversion leaves. She holds against the hunters, asks for healing and continues as new creatures arrive. After she is swallowed, Eugene’s Wish destroys the attackers; the narrator records her dead body among their remains.

Arjahn casts Revivify and she returns to life. The diamond is explicitly not consumed on this occasion. She calls the loss sleep, embraces him and later helps the spent Eugene back toward shelter. Her wording preserves her own experience; the narrator’s death and return remain distinct outcomes.

When the diversion’s pursuers reach the Refuge, she fights again despite her wounds. A creature’s eye reduces her to ash. Eugene collects the remains at Elenia’s request. After the later mountain assault, Elenia takes out the ashes and calls Nymera back; a separate completion or named spell is not recorded in that closing passage. By the September gathering Nymera is working at the Refuge again and says she died twice. Her living presence is established without inventing the second return’s exact method.

Shared faith without ownership

During the mountain expedition, Nymera’s relationship to Cala overlaps with Elenia’s without becoming subordinate to it. Elenia asks where the boundary lies, accepts “no,” and sends Nymera home through Gate. Shared devotion does not grant one follower authority over another’s continued participation.

Offering help among specialists

During the Luminar Spires expedition, Nymera offers help with imprisonment, locating and supporting the group, digging, tunneling, flight or rescue, and other physical needs. She does this even when the arcane theory exceeds her knowledge.

After misunderstanding Scribonia’s proposed magical prison, Nymera apologizes. Arjahn and Scribonia tell her not to and affirm that her help will matter elsewhere. The exchange begins a possible confidence and belonging thread: uncertainty about contribution does not make the contribution unwanted.

Returning to the walls

At Pristinia’s walls, Nymera’s contribution is physical and repeatable. She brings tools, carries stone and hauls logs, telling that her goal is to advance the guard tower. The work matters to the town even when she has no clear answer about what she wants for herself.

Primary scene: 1, 2, 3, 4. Dates refer to Discord posts.

6 September 2025 · Work and bad memories

Pappy says he likes working with his hands. Nymera says the work helps her not think, then explains that it leaves her less focused on bad memories. She also says she cannot easily choose what she should do, but helping here seems worthwhile. This directly links labor to relief; that September 2025 conversation does not reveal the memories themselves. Her later October 2026 mist experience adds the personal context recorded below.

Primary scene: 1, 2, 3, 4. Dates refer to Discord posts.

“Yes... it make me, less foccussed on bad memories...”Nymera · Pristinia Walls, 6 September 2025 posting date

Payment does not answer every question

explains why a large construction project needs paid workers. Nymera asks whether everyone came for money, then asks his own reason for working. She calls herself not materialistic, with worn and scratched clothing, but admits she does not know what she needs. Her questions seek people’s motives as well as the project’s practical requirements.

Primary scene: 1, 2, 3, 4, 5. Dates refer to Discord posts.

An old axe she cannot easily replace

Nymera is discouraged because her axe did little damage during training. Marius suggests better equipment, but she says she cannot part with the greataxe, calling it something she has still kept. Her attachment complicates any claim that possessions mean nothing to her. The axe matters personally, although its history is not supplied.

Primary scene: 1, 2, 3, 4, 5. Dates refer to Discord posts.

Asking what other people want

While carrying stone with Ghilsen, Nymera asks about his goals in life. Read beside her uncertainty with Marius and Pappy, the question suggests a person considering purpose through conversation as well as work. That is an interpretation of a recurring pattern, not proof of thoughts she has not voiced.

Primary scene: 1, 2. Dates refer to Discord posts.

Keeping something standing

In the November 2025 walls exchange, Nymera says she keeps what she can standing and hopes other people do not receive scars. Her own hands are described as scarred and trembling, and she leaves when tired. The cause of those scars remains unknown. Her sparse speech and repeated work carry this history without requiring an invented trauma or diagnosis.

Primary scene: 1, 2, 3. Dates refer to Discord posts.

The open record

Nymera’s earlier life, the memories she avoids, the origins of her scars and the history of her greataxe remain unresolved. Her full relationship to Cala and her later choices require further evidence. The practical help she offers is already part of the record.

October · the lost child and the companion she carries

Nymera fights the salamander, offers to pull Arjahn’s tether and later enters the fog tied to Olokun and Ryvyt. When Olokun is affected, she restrains him and tries to carry him toward the beach. Then she sees a lost child she calls Elyndra. She releases him and follows, caught by the hope that she can reach her daughter.

Her reactions recall a burned home, flight and separation. The mist turns Ryvyt into an apparent attacker and makes the child’s distress seem immediate. These are Nymera’s memories and perceptions under its influence, not independent proof of Elyndra’s present location, survival or fate. Her older admission that work quiets bad memories now has a more specific personal context.

Ryvyt’s Dispel Magic frees her before Scribonia’s Wish clears the wider mist. The release is not an instant end to fear: she worries about the beach, asks after burn marks and asks the others not to tell. Olokun agrees. Later, she quietly says an imperfect world still needs protection, accepts Wren’s encouragement and food, and carries Scribonia toward the refuge. The person who needed help becomes a source of help again without the story declaring her grief healed.

September and early October · making room to protect

Nymera asks to join Olokun and Scribonia outside the Refuge while worrying that her strength is less useful than their magic. In the September spider fight she repeatedly tries to stop creatures reaching her companions. Her tears are described as grief for those she has seen fall, rather than proof that she is unwilling to fight.

On the next recorded hunt she again puts herself between danger and Scribonia. The company defeats the spiders and Olokun heals their wounds. Nymera continues looking for useful stone, hoping Arjahn can use what she finds. At the coast afterward she rests with her greataxe close by. Protection, gathering and the difficulty of relaxing remain connected, before the later mist expedition.

Accepting help while trying to be useful

At the Refuge, Nymera trains by lifting and stacking rocks, worrying that strength is all she can offer beside powerful magic. Adelia reassures her that magic is not always the answer. When Saray proposes working in Prima, Nymera asks who will keep her safe while she rests and offers supplies. Her concern extends beyond taking blows in a fight.

After carrying Scribonia home, she brings him water and wishes him well. On the later metal search she asks Arjahn how to pray, then places herself between a spider and Scribonia. Arjahn’s treatment of her poisoning and wounds lets care move toward her as well. Her question about protection from fear remains a question, not a discovered property of metal.

Scenes in sequence

Selected scenes follow choices, knowledge and consequences. Dates identify UTC source postings; this October session was played on 18 October in New York.

    A first death and an explicit Revivify

    Nymera dies during the first Refuge defense and Arjahn restores her with Revivify; the diamond remains unconsumed.

    Known at this stage
    The defenders have only a brief respite.
    Consequence
    She returns to helping her exhausted companions.
    Still unresolved
    The local exception does not promise effortless or unlimited returns.

    Nymera fights again and is reduced to ash; Eugene gathers the remains for an attempted later restoration.

    Known at this stage
    The Refuge is saved while she is lost.
    Consequence
    Elenia later calls her back over the ashes; September shows her living again.
    Still unresolved

    Strength is offered as protection

    Nymera asks to join the hunt and repeatedly tries to keep spiders from reaching her companions.

    Known at this stage
    She doubts the value of weapons beside powerful magic.
    Consequence
    Her actions make her protective intention visible.
    Still unresolved

    The work continues after the fight

    Nymera helps defeat the spiders, accepts healing and collects useful stone before resting at the coast.

    Known at this stage
    The hunt has caused injuries but the party remains together.
    Consequence
    Gathering and keeping watch continue alongside grief.

    A rescue interrupted by the lost-child vision

    Nymera tries to carry Olokun out, then releases him when the mist presents a lost child she calls Elyndra.

    Known at this stage
    She believes her daughter is close and in danger; Ryvyt appears threatening.
    Consequence
    Her practical strength cannot protect her from the same field that has affected the others.
    Still unresolved

    Freed before the wider clearing, then carrying another

    Ryvyt’s Dispel Magic frees Nymera before the Wish; later she carries the exhausted Scribonia toward the refuge.

    Known at this stage
    Her fear persists after release, and she asks the others not to share what happened.
    Consequence
    Care is reciprocal: she receives reassurance and food, then helps another companion return.
    Still unresolved
    Neither instant emotional recovery nor permanent healing of her burn marks is established.

The gap between ashes and a living return

Eugene gathers Nymera’s ashes after the second attack. In the 29 August source sequence Elenia receives them, postpones the attempt until after the mountain operation, and later calls Nymera back at the base. The checked closing sequence contains neither a named casting nor a separate narration of the awakening. By the September scene Nymera is living and helping at the Refuge.

This bounds the missing transition between an attempted return and a witnessed living appearance. It does not establish which spell completed it, the exact time or an unseen ruling. Arjahn’s earlier Revivify remains a separate restoration.

profile.personality: Sparse and hesitant in speech, Nymera asks other people what motivates them while uncertain about her own direction. Wall work helps her focus less on bad memories; her scarred hands do not establish their cause.
profile.achievements: Repeatedly carries stone, hauls logs and assists guard-tower work in Pristinia. Her devotion to Cala and practical help during mountain and Luminar Spires expeditions remain part of her history.
profile.relationships: Pappy shares the work and discusses painful memories; Marius explains paid labor and suggests equipment while she remains attached to her old axe; she asks Ghilsen about his goals in life. Elenia, Arjahn and Scribonia feature in her earlier faith and expedition records.
